alternate_names: Veera Hanuman Temple (as listed on wikitravel.org)
deities: Lord Anjaneya Swamy (Hanuman) - swayambhu (self-manifested) main idol
festivals: Hanuman Jayanti (main festival; ~4 lakh devotees attend; many observe 41-day Hanuman Deeksha)

history.period: Legend dates the idol's discovery to ~300 years ago; the present structure was built by Krishna Rao Deshmukh in the mid-20th century
history.summary: CSV TOWN CORRECTION: the CSV lists 'Karimnagar' as the town; the temple is actually at Kondagattu village in Jagtial district, ~35-40 km from Karimnagar city (2 km from Kondagattu Bus Stand, 14 km from Jagtial). Legend: about 300 years ago Singam Sanjeevudu, searching for a lost buffalo, found an illuminating swayambhu idol of Anjaneya in a hill cave after the lord appeared in his dream; he built the first small shrine. The present structure was built by Krishna Rao Deshmukh in the mid-20th century. The temple sits on a hillock amid hills, valleys and springs; it is believed to be a spot where Hanuman set foot during his search for Sita. Devotees undertake a 40-day prayer tradition for blessings (childless couples, healing). Festivals: Hanuman Jayanti is the main festival.

name: Kondagattu Anjaneya Swamy Temple
town_description: Kondagattu is a village in Mallial mandal of Jagtial district, Telangana, ~35-40 km from Karimnagar city. The temple crowns a scenic hillock surrounded by hills, valleys and natural springs; nearby attractions include Kondalaraya Fort and the Bojjapotana caves.

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad - about 200 km (per travelsetu.com; verify).
travel.railway: Karimnagar railway station - nearest railhead (per travelsetu.com; verify).
travel.road: ~35 km from Karimnagar city by road; 2 km from Kondagattu Bus Stand and 14 km from Jagtial Bus Station (per trawell.in).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Hanuman Jayanti (March/April) for the main festival atmosphere (expect heavy crowds).
visitor_information.opening_hours: 4:00 AM to 8:30 PM daily, with a midday closure 1:30 PM to 3:00 PM (per poojn.in; verify). Conflicting source (shrihanumanjichalisa.com) reports 6:00 AM-12:00 PM and 4:00-8:00 PM - verify before visiting.
